ignite.reason: The declared org.apache.ignite:ignite-client:2.18.0 coordinate is unavailable; Ignite 2 documents ignite-core while ignite-client metadata begins at Ignite 3.

byte-buddy.reason: Preserve the unqualified JVM 8+ Byte Buddy channel; the upstream release marker points to the separate jdk5 variant.

hibernate73.reason: Preserve the Hibernate ORM 7.3 compatibility line used by the Javers integration.

jakarta-persistence-v31.reason: Preserve the Jakarta Persistence 3.1 API compatibility line.

jsonassert-v2.reason: The 2.x line has only release candidates and no stable Maven Central release.

junit-platform6-runner.reason: Maven Central publishes junit-platform-runner only on the 1.x line; the declared 6.x artifact version is unavailable.

kotlin.reason: Keep all Kotlin compiler and Gradle plugin aliases on the approved 2.4.10 line.

logback.reason: Align Logback classic and core to Spring Boot 4.1.0's managed 1.5.34 pair; mixing logback-classic 1.6.x with the managed core line causes an AbstractMethodError.

kafka4.reason: Preserve Kafka 4.2.1 because Spring Kafka 4.1.0 and spring-kafka-test manage the embedded-test artifacts at 4.2.1.

netty4.reason: Preserve the Netty 4.1 ABI line required by Vert.x 4 and Fabric8 consumers.
